Set Up Working Schedules and Public Holidays

User manual · English · 15 steps
Learn how to define the hours people work by creating a working schedule, and how to record a public holiday so it is excluded from working time and leave.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Working Schedules

Click Working Schedules.

4. New schedule

Click New to create a working schedule.

5. Schedule name

Type a name for the schedule, then press Tab.

6. Full-time hours

Type the company's full-time hours per week, then press Tab.

7. Save

Click the save icon to keep the schedule.

8. Home menu

Click the home menu icon to go back to your apps.

9. Open Time Off

Open the Time Off app.

10. Time Off configuration

Open the Configuration menu.

11. Public Holidays

Click Public Holidays.

12. New public holiday

Click New to add a public holiday.

13. Holiday name

Type the name of the holiday, then press Tab.

14. Save the holiday

Click Save to record the holiday.

15. Holiday saved

The holiday is saved. Click the column headings of the list to finish.
